details.biography:
Jacob's Well (first Keepers) · Seat 6, Spare: healer

A weather-lined woman from the far north, hair in bone-pinned braids, who talks to the wind as if it owes her money. She sees the spirits of a place the way others see furniture, and she is rarely surprised by either. The Keepers hired her to read the weather; she stayed because they kept walking into places the spirits warned her about.

Tonight: The spirits around this inn are frightened of something inside it, and they won't say what.

In a fight

Entangle a pack before it reaches the line, Faerie Fire anything that hides, and keep Hulda's patients standing with Cure Light Wounds. Barkskin the front-liner before a big fight; when cornered, Wild Shape into something with teeth.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities

Spellcasting. Wisdom. Spell save DC 14. Slots: 4 cantrips, three 1st, two 2nd. Prepare 6 spells each morning from the whole Druid list. No metal armour or shield. See the spell page.

Wild Shape. Twice a day, as your action, become a beast (or one of the listed beast-like monsters) of Level 1 or lower for up to an hour, using its whole stat block from Monsters & Treasure. You keep your mind; you can't cast in a form that can't speak, and when the form drops to 0 HP you return with the HP you had.

Resist Elements (2nd). Advantage on saves against fire, water, earth, air, cold and lightning attacks.

Woodland Stride (3rd). Move through natural difficult terrain (thorns, briars, deep snow-choked undergrowth) at full speed, leaving no trail. Magical terrain still hinders you.

Nature Lore (Wisdom). In the far north, identify plants and animals perfectly, tell whether water is safe, and find shelter and food for one person; elsewhere it takes a Wisdom check. Feeding more takes 6 hours of foraging and a Moderate Wisdom (Survival) check, and feeds 2d4 more.

Kit: Shaman. Spirit Sight: Advantage on checks to perceive, talk to or identify spirits, ancestors and natural beings from beyond. During a long rest, ask the spirits one yes or no question about the area or a creature nearby; the answer comes as an impression, not words. Ancestor's Fury: in Wild Shape, your first hit each round deals an extra 1d4 damage of a type you choose.

Iron Constitution (Human bonus feat). Advantage on saves against poison and disease, and +1 Constitution (included).

Potent Casting (feat, 1st). Your spells ignore damage resistance (not immunity).

Human. Advantage on Survival checks (chosen skill). You speak Druidic, the circle's secret tongue, and Giant, from the northern traders.

Casting

Other good picks tonight: Thunderwave, Alarm (1st); Speak with Animals, Hold Animal, Warp Wood (2nd).

Armour Class on the sheet: Cuir bouille +4, Dex +1

Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast divine spells per the Spells Per Day table. Bonus slots from high Wisdom (see Spellcasting in Arneyan, II).

Bonus Language

  • Effect: Gain the secret druidic tongue: forbidden to teach to non-druids.
  • High Intelligence also unlocks: Elvish, Giant, Gnomish, Primordial, Sylvan

Nature Lore (Wisdom)

  • Effect: Identify plants and animals perfectly within the Druid's trained region.
  • Determine if water is safe to drink
  • Find basic shelter and enough food for one person automatically
  • Feeding additional people takes 6 hours of foraging and a Moderate Wisdom (Survival) check, and feeds an extra 2d4 people
  • Unfamiliar regions require a Wisdom check for all of the above

Wild Shape

  • Effect: As your action, shapeshift into any beast or beast-like monster of Level no greater than half your Druid level, rounded down (minimum Level 1), once per day (more often as you rise in level, below), choosing the form fresh each time (any beast in Monsters & Treasure, or one of these beast-like monsters: Owlbear, Death Dog, Hippogriff, Griffon, Ankheg, Bulette, Carrion Crawler, Grick, Grick Alpha, Hook Horror, Young Remorhaz, Hydra, Piercer and Rust Monster; others at the GM's call, but never a solo, an intelligent or a magical creature).
  • Lasts up to 1 hour or until you choose to revert.
  • You take the form's whole stat block from Monsters & Treasure: its HP, AC, attacks, saves and movement.
  • You keep your own mind, personality and Wisdom-based abilities, and you cannot cast spells in a form that cannot speak.
  • When the form drops to 0 HP you return to your own form with the HP you had when you changed (see Changing Shape in Spellcasting in Arneyan).
  • 3rd level: usable twice per day
  • 6th level: usable three times per day
  • 9th level: usable four times per day
  • 15th level: usable five times per day
  • 24th level: usable six times per day

2nd Level

Resist Elements

  • Effect: Advantage on saves vs fire, water, earth, air, cold, and lightning attacks.

3rd Level

Woodland Stride

  • Effect: Move through natural difficult terrain, thorns, briars, overgrowth, at full speed with no damage or impairment, leaving no trail.
  • Magically manipulated terrain still impedes normally

4th Level

Beast Kin

  • Effect: Natural beasts treat you one step friendlier on reaction rolls, and won't attack you first unless cornered, starving or magically compelled.

5th Level

Perfect Recall

  • Effect: Once per day, cast a 1st-level spell you have already cast today without expending a slot.
  • 24th level: a 2nd-level spell.

6th Level

Wild Shape Casting

  • Effect: While in Wild Shape, you may cast spells from your prepared list that have only verbal or no components.
  • Spells requiring somatic components cannot be cast while shifted
  • Your Wisdom modifier applies normally to all spells cast in this way

7th Level

Primal Strikes

  • Effect: Your natural attacks in Wild Shape count as magical.

8th Level

Elemental Mastery

  • Effect: Choose one element: fire, cold, lightning, earth, water, or air. You have Resistance to its damage.

9th Level

Language of the Wilderlands

  • Effect: Communicate with the beasts native to your Nature Lore regions through their natural sounds and motions.

10th Level

Wild Shape Casting improves

  • Effect: From 10th level, you may also cast spells with somatic components while shifted.

12th Level

Deepened Shape

  • Effect: Your Wild Shape Level cap rises to your full Druid level instead of half (so a 12th-level Druid can become any beast or monster of Level 12 or lower).
  • Shifting also now grants temporary HP equal to twice your Druid level, lasting until the shift ends or the temp HP is depleted.
  • The form's HP cannot exceed your own Max HP.

13th Level

Advanced Nature Lore

  • Effect: Nature Lore now extends to a second region or regional type, fully functional including foraging.
  • Extends to a third region at 21st level

15th Level

  • Wisdom Bonus: permanent +1 Wisdom

18th Level

Dismiss Woodland Creatures (Wisdom)

  • Effect: Dismiss any animal, beast, plant, or vermin native to one of the Druid's Nature Lore regions.
  • Wisdom check, DC = 10 + total Levels of the creatures being dismissed
  • Each day the Druid can dismiss Levels worth of creatures equal to 10 + Wisdom modifier without penalty
  • Dismissed creatures flee and don't return until the Druid departs

20th Level

Elemental Mastery (Improved)

  • Effect: You are now immune to your chosen element's damage entirely.
  • When struck by a spell of that element, make a Wisdom check against the spell's save DC
  • Succeed on the check: the spell is reflected back at a target of the Druid's choice for its original damage

Renown: Sacred Grove

  • Effect: You may found a sacred grove (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 1d4 initiates and the grove's beasts gather to it. While you hold it, you have one extra Wild Shape a day within a day's travel of the grove.

21st Level

Language of the Wilderlands (Improved)

  • Effect: You can now communicate with any bird, beast, tree, or growing thing via their natural method: sound, motion, communion.
  • Most creatures have limited understanding — expect simple impressions, not tactical reports

24th Level

Awaken Woodland Spirit

  • Effect: Spend several days with a plant or animal to fully awaken it: grants human-level consciousness, speech in the Druid's tongue, two extra HD, maximum HP, and +2 to AC, damage, and saves.
  • The awakened creature remains loyal to the Druid for life
  • Maximum awakened HD at any time = twice your Druid level

Kits: Druidic Circles

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Druid folder. Drag one onto your character.

  • Druid Kits represent which circle a Druid was trained in. The Cabal is an overarching druidic organisation with multiple regional circles, each led by a Hierophant. Mournas has its own independent circle separate from the Cabal's structure.

Druid Spell List

Spells available to the Druid, by level. * = reversible spell. ‡ = needs a costed material component (see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue). Full descriptions, saves and components are in Spellcasting in Arneyan.

Spells Per Day

  • Bonus Spells: Wisdom 13–15 grants an extra 1st level spell, 16–17 an extra 2nd level spell, 18+ an extra 3rd level spell. Cumulative, and only acquired once the Druid is high enough level to cast that tier.
